def bf16_round(x):
    a = np.array(x, dtype=np.float32, copy=True)
    bits = a.view(np.uint32)
    bits += np.uint32(0x7fff) + ((bits >> np.uint32(16)) & np.uint32(1))
    bits &= np.uint32(0xffff0000)
    return a

def stage_columns(name, selected, desired_columns, label, metadata):
    selected = np.asarray(selected, dtype=np.int64)

    tensor_norm = float(np.linalg.norm(w))

    assert len(np.unique(selected)) == len(selected)
    assert np.isfinite(desired_columns).all()

    effective_delta = absolute - original_columns
    support = int(np.count_nonzero(effective_delta))

        "relative_tensor_norm": float(np.linalg.norm(effective_delta)) / tensor_norm,
        "rounding_error_norm": float(np.linalg.norm(effective_delta - intended_delta)),
        **metadata,
